veranderings.voor: lê 'n dun dowwe lagie oor blink metaal
veranderings.na: lê 'n dun dowwe lagie oor die blink metaal
veranderings.rede: The article makes it clear the shiny metal is the coin's own metal underneath, which reads more naturally.

veranderings.voor: Skuur haal die lagie af en die blink metaal
veranderings.na: Skuur haal die lagie af, en die blink metaal
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Kryt het geen sulke lagie nie en skuur
veranderings.na: Kryt het nie so 'n lagie nie, en skuur
veranderings.rede: 'so 'n lagie' is the natural singular form instead of 'sulke lagie', and the AWS comma is needed before 'en' joining two clauses.

veranderings.na: wanneer iemand dit probeer buig nie
veranderings.rede: Chalk cannot be bent, so 'probeer buig' avoids saying someone bends it while the sentence says it does not bend.

veranderings.voor: Daardie selfde harde klip breek tog in stukke wanneer 'n hamer hom hard
veranderings.na: Dieselfde harde klip breek tog in stukke wanneer 'n hamer dit hard
veranderings.rede: 'Dieselfde' is the natural form instead of 'daardie selfde', and 'dit' is the standard written pronoun for an object.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: help mense besluit wat hulle waarmee maak
veranderings.na: help mense besluit van watter materiaal hulle iets maak
veranderings.rede: 'wat hulle waarmee maak' is a compressed, hard-to-parse construction for a Grade 5 reader.

veranderings.voor: van metaal gemaak en dit kan
veranderings.na: van metaal gemaak, en dit kan
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: van klip gebou en klip hoef
veranderings.na: van klip gebou, en klip hoef
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
'Albei soorte' has no noun and the reader must guess what kinds are meant; 'materiaal' makes the reference clear.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
'Baie plastiek' reads as 'a lot of plastic'; 'baie soorte plastiek' says many kinds, which is what is meant, and keeps the qualifier.
